tasks.title: Add project null check to all 5 worktree-using endpoints
tasks.description: In packages/cli/src/api/issues.ts, add `if (!project) { log.warn(...); return c.json({success:false,error:'Project not found'},404); }` after `const project = projectService.getById(projectId)` in 5 endpoints: start (L431), reopen (L679), approve (L960), reject (L1081), messages (L1173). For start endpoint, the check must go BEFORE the stage transition at L437. Reference propose.ts:60-66 for the exact pattern.
acceptanceCriteria: start endpoint returns 404 with {success:false,error:'Project not found'} when project is null, before stage transition
reopen endpoint returns 404 when project is null
approve endpoint returns 404 when project is null
reject endpoint returns 404 when project is null
messages endpoint returns 404 when project is null
Each null check logs warn with projectId and issueNumber
No remaining `let worktreePath = process.cwd()` pattern without preceding project null guard
tasks.notes: All 5 fixes are in a single file, same mechanical pattern. No need to split into separate tasks.
